instruction_summary: Study B (002/003 theory-update): fit a friction-convergence law to HHJK's group frictions extended to 2023 (001), backtest it and classify each group as continued/slowed/stalled/reversed, split the 2010-23 change into tauH/tauW, project remaining output gains to 2033/2043/tau_inf, and write down the updated model. Reuse 001 only; fetch nothing; new Octave only for projections.

steps.description: Read 001 living-update deliverables (finished by 002-living-update-cont): report, result_card, tau_paths, growth_shares, remaining_gain, robustness_summary
Create venv; extract meanlogtau/varlogtau/TauH_T/TauW/baseline GDP from 001's saved .mat (Living,R1-R5,R8)
Item 1: fit convergence law per group (1960-2010, true midpoints), backtest 1960-2000->2010, out-of-sample 2023, per-decade rates, pre-registered stall classification
Item 2: exact tauH/tauW decomposition of the 2010-23 ln tau-hat change (primary, R5, R8)
Item 3 validation: zero-shift projection reproduces 001's 2023 baseline (Ymkt 61793.1, gain 0.000%)
Item 3: 3 projection solves x 3 specs (primary/R5/R8) at 2033,2043,tau_inf; stage-split, <=66s each, never backgrounded

key_results.stall_classification: WW=continued, BM=slowed, BW=slowed (none stalled or reversed)
key_results.post2010_split_tauH_share: WW 53%, BM 126%, BW 88% (tauW flat; robust R5/R8)

comparison_to_original.note: historical anchor for the forward comparison

comparison_to_original.followup: consistent; law shows this is on-trend deceleration, not a stall

comparison_to_original.quantity: Remaining gain if all frictions removed, 2023 (L5)
comparison_to_original.followup: ~8.8% stays permanently unrealised even at tau->tau_inf

deviations: Projection realises the composite-friction decline through the labour-market wedge tauW in period 7 only (keeps it a clean comparative static; zero-shift reproduces baseline exactly); realising via tauH would modestly change output levels. Dispersion held at 2023 (parallel mean shift); the fitted variance law is reported but not imposed on the projection. All projection numbers labelled [PROJECTED, conditional].
WW/BW stall verdict is low-power (large backtest errors 0.19/0.13 -> wide bands b); BM's is confident. Stated explicitly.
R5/R8 projections run in addition to the required primary (spec budget anticipated them); R7 (theta sweep) optional, not run.
Study A (§A/001) out of this launch's scope; its artifacts used as inputs, not re-run.
